Maintaining Energy and Protein Intake
Nutritional status has an important effect on a patient’s quality of life, sense of well-being, ability 
to fight disease and withstand the rigors of anticancer treatments. Early and sustained nutritional 
support is one of the most valuable adjuncts to the optimal management of cancer. Healthcare 
professionals should help patients aim to prevent weight loss, reduce muscle wasting, and avoid 
nutrient deficiencies. Weight management, and weight gain if possible, should be considered
